title: 20,000 Subscribers
trivia: It is implied that Agent 8 makes the subscriber special cake. In this render, it is mainly shown by Agent 8 being beside the cake alongside Agent Z.
This is the first subscriber render in 2026 and since the 10,000 Subscriber Render on the 14th of August 2025, just under a year prior.

The items surrounding the characters each represent an episode released between Squid Game and Truth or Dare, being the episodes released while the agent z YouTube Channel had 10,000 to 19,999 subscribers. These two episodes are also referenced through items to the left and right of Neo Agent 3.

Only one Splatshort is directly referenced, being 'Age Verification Needed.' through the phone, which also references Lost Phone, as the Splatshort gained a lot of popularity for its recent relevance with changing laws on social media worldwide.
Agent X, Agent 3 and Neo Agent 3 also reference episodes through their poses, being The Sewer Monster, Cooking Together, and Locked Out respectively.
The characters are arranged deliberately to form the letter 'W'., in reference to Agent W, the computer entity.

title: Truth or Dare
trivia: Thumbnail for Truth or Dare.
The thumbnail was originally meant to be temporary to get the episode released on time, but due to the episode's rapid growth, the thumbnail stayed.

The thumbnail has both Agent Z and Neo Agent 3 rendered together as opposed to them having their own individual renders. This can be most seen by Agent Z's headphones casting a shadow on Neo Agent 3's ear.

The thumbnail is meant to represent the most common Truth and Dare submissions that weren't included in the episode. Agent Z represents various truth questions asking for romantic interests or favorite friends, while Neo Agent 3 represents various dare submissions asking characters to interact with boiling water or water in general.

title: The Cockroach Incident
trivia: Thumbnail for The Cockroach Incident.
To make the thumbnails, agent z had to search up images of cockroaches. Not very pleasant.
The third variant references The SPIDER with their thumbnail also having a silhouette of the bug and characters running away.

Each thumbnail is intended to capture a different emotion. The first variant shows Agent Z's determination to kill the cockroach, the second variant shows her nervousness, and the third variant shows her fear.

title: YOU Decide, Truth or Dare!?
trivia: This is the first post requesting viewer submissions since The Perfect Present had viewer submissions open back on the 25th of November 2024, 582 days prior.

This post allowing viewer submissions has far surpassed the previous record for viewer submissions, being The Perfect Present's viewer submissions which had a combined 193 comments across YouTube, Twitter and Bluesky. As of the 5th of July, this post has 346 comments, being 153 comments ahead on YouTube alone.
This is also the first render to feature all 5 of the main characters in 2026.

title: Locked Out
trivia: Thumbnail for Locked Out.
The first variant was orginally a rushed placeholder as agent z was running low on time to make the thumbnail.
In a thumbnail test against all three variants however, the rushed thumbnail ended up winning and therefore is the current thumbnail.
If the third variant had won the thumbnail test, it would've been the first instance of a Splatoon Idol appearing in the thumbnail in a mainline Splatoon Animation.
All three variants use the same house map in Garry's Mod, called 'Chill House'. The third variant is just indoors and has an edited outdoors.

title: NOT THE GAMES!!
trivia: There is no particular order for the game cases in the background, aside from Splatoon 3 being intentionally at the end.

The Nintendo Switch 2 Pro Controller's box sits next to the Nintendo Switch 2 box at the top of the background, but can be hard to see as it blends with the white walls. A small amount of its text can be seen.
The room's lighting was edited through image editing tools to be brighter and have a purple tint.
All game cases are notably developed by Nintendo aside from one that features game company Ubisoft and their logo on the spine. This game is 'Just Dance 2021'.
This render was mentioned again by agent z in a tweet referencing Sony's decision to stop producing physical Playstation games by 2028, announced on the 1st of July 2026.

The second variant was posted through YouTube Community posts as agent z also found the drawing cute when zoomed up.
This is currently agent z's most favorite drawing they have made.

title: Target the Anchor
trivia: This render was originally just made to practice posing after agent z returned from overseas following the release of The Countdown and wasn't meant to tease at any future episode. This render marked the change where YouTube Community Posts were reserved for renders referencing Splatoon Animations, while extra renders would be posted to Twitter and Bluesky instead.
The weapons Agent Z and Agent X use reference the Power Trip Story Arc, with Agent Z using an Ultra Stamp to defeat Agent X, using an unmodified Hydra Splatling.
The render references Agent Z's playstyle in Splatoon 3 itself and their dislike towards long-ranged backlines, as she mains the Sploosh-o-matic.
